{{Quote|The syringe on the platform contains a highly electrolytic serum that will allow you to pass through the shield. However, it is toxic to all but one of you.|Moralo Eval to the tournament contestants|<ref name="The Box">{{TCW|The Box}}</ref>}}
'''Electrolytic serum''' was a substance that when injected into the bloodstream of a particular species, allowed them to pass through an electrified [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shield]].<ref name="The Box" />

==History==
[[File:DerrownPassesThruShield-TB.png|thumb|left|200px|Derrown passes through the ray shield]]
{{Quote|He's a Parwan. His blood can take the electrolytic serum.|Obi-Wan Kenobi, to the other contestants|<ref name="The Box" />}}
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] discovered a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] plot to kidnap [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] during a celebration on his [[Homeworld/Legends|home]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], disguised as [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Rako Hardeen/Legends|Rako Hardeen]], joined forces with [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] and [[Moralo Eval/Legends|Moralo Eval]], the mastermind of the kidnapping plot. After arriving on [[Serenno/Legends|Serenno]], Bane and Hardeen were invited by [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to join ten other bounty hunters named [[Sixtat/Legends|Sixtat]], [[Embo/Legends|Embo]], [[Twazzi/Legends|Twazzi]], [[Mantu/Legends|Mantu]], [[Jakoli/Legends|Jakoli]], [[Kiera Swan/Legends|Kiera Swan]], [[Onca/Legends|Onca]], [[Bulduga/Legends|Bulduga]], [[Derrown/Legends|Derrown]], and [[Sinrich/Legends|Sinrich]] in a [[Tournament on Serenno/Legends|tournament]] of skill within [[Box/Legends|The Box]].<ref name="The Box" />

After two tests were completed, eight surviving competitors were enclosed in a room blocked by electrified [[Ray shield/Legends|ray shielded]] floor and three walls. The fourth wall contained a switch to deactivate the ray shields, hidden behind a small ray shield. A syringe containing a highly concentrated electrolytic serum toxic to all but one of the six remaining contestants stood in the middle of the room. The [[Parwan/Legends|Parwan]] Derrown's physiology allowed him to survive the serum injection in order to pass through the shield relatively unharmed and deactivate the remaining shields.<ref name="The Box" />
